title: Bug: [Trixie] dash-ha@dpu<n>.service is started even when the feature is not enabled
author: tirupatihemanth
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

We see from the unit file below that dash-ha@dpu<n>.sevice is started with ExecCondition when it is either npu or dpu (with is-npu-or-dpu.sh). But we shouldn't start this service unless the dash-ha feature is enabled. We need to update the logic for when these services are started. 

```
root@sonic:/var/log# systemctl cat dash-ha@dpu0
# /usr/lib/systemd/system/dash-ha@.service
[Unit]
Description=DASH HA container
Requires=database@%i.service config-setup.service swss.service
After=database@%i.service swss.service interfaces-config.service
BindsTo=sonic.target
After=sonic.target
Before=ntp-config.service
StartLimitIntervalSec=1200
StartLimitBurst=3

[Service]
User=admin
ExecCondition=/bin/bash /usr/local/bin/is-npu-or-dpu.sh
ExecStartPre=/usr/local/bin/dash-ha.sh start %i
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/dash-ha.sh wait %i
ExecStop=/usr/local/bin/dash-ha.sh stop %i
RestartSec=30

[Install]
WantedBy=sonic.target

# /run/systemd/generator/dash-ha@.service.d/environment.conf
[Service]
Environment="NUM_DPU=4"
Environment="IS_DPU_DEVICE=false"

```

This is cause the following failures

```
root@sonic:/var/log# systemctl status dash-ha@dpu0
× dash-ha@dpu0.service - DASH HA container
     Loaded: loaded (/usr/lib/systemd/system/dash-ha@.service; enabled-runtime; preset: enabled)
    Drop-In: /run/systemd/generator/dash-ha@.service.d
             environment.conf
     Active: failed (Result: exit-code) since Mon 2025-11-17 17:30:48 UTC; 7h ago
   Duration: 373ms
 Invocation: 0ffc41a7b1c74b14881fa2eb7134a920
   Main PID: 25039 (code=exited, status=255/EXCEPTION)
   Mem peak: 30.3M
        CPU: 566ms

Nov 17 17:30:48 sonic systemd[1]: Started dash-ha@dpu0.service - DASH HA container.
Nov 17 17:30:48 sonic container[25060]: container_wait: BEGIN
Nov 17 17:30:48 sonic container[25060]: read_data: config:True feature:dash-hadpu0 fields:[('set_owner', 'local'), ('no_fallback_to_local', False), ('state', 'disabled')] val:['local', False, 'disabled']
Nov 17 17:30:48 sonic container[25060]: read_data: config:False feature:dash-hadpu0 fields:[('current_owner', 'none'), ('remote_state', 'none'), ('container_id', '')] val:['none', 'none', '']
Nov 17 17:30:48 sonic container[25060]: docker get image version for dash-hadpu0 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.50/containers/dash-hadpu0/json: Not Found ("No such container: dash-hadpu0")
Nov 17 17:30:48 sonic container[25060]: container_wait: dash-hadpu0: set_owner:local ct_owner:none state:none id:dash-hadpu0 pend=0
Nov 17 17:30:48 sonic container[25060]: container_wait: END -- transitioning to docker wait
Nov 17 17:30:48 sonic docker-rs[25060]: Unable to wait on container: Docker error
Nov 17 17:30:48 sonic systemd[1]: dash-ha@dpu0.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=255/EXCEPTION
Nov 17 17:30:48 sonic systemd[1]: dash-ha@dpu0.service: Failed with result 'exit-code'.

```


### Steps to Reproduce

Reboot the device to find the following error in syslog on a Smartswitch
```
ERR container: docker get image version for dash-hadpu3 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.50/containers/dash-hadpu3/json: Not Found ("No such container: dash-hadpu3")
2025 Nov  7 08:26:00.686475 sonic ERR container: docker get image version for dash-hadpu3 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.50/containers/dash-hadpu3/json: Not Found ("No such container: dash-hadpu3")
2025 Nov  7 08:26:00.686745 sonic ERR container: docker get image version for dash-hadpu1 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.50/containers/dash-hadpu1/json: Not Found ("No such container: dash-hadpu1")
2025 Nov  7 08:26:00.687632 sonic ERR container: docker get image version for dash-hadpu2 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.50/containers/dash-hadpu2/json: Not Found ("No such container: dash-hadpu2")
```

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual Behavior: dash-hadpu@dpu<n>.service is started on every smartswitch npu/dpu. It must only start on the npu of a smartswitch which has dash ha feature enabled


### UPDATE: DPU SIDE
--The issue with the same-root cause is also observed on the DPU--
Similarly on the dpu side we have dash-ha.service which is using the same ExecCondition (is-npu-or-dpu.sh) and always starting on dpu whether dash-ha feature is enabled or not causing the following failure. The dpu side needs to be updated as well.

```
syslog.1:3546:2025 Nov 20 14:00:44.180770 sonic ERR resolv-config: [update-containers:update_container_resolv] Failed to start container dash-ha (23ada928ec34)
yslog.1:3502:2025 Nov 20 14:00:43.351405 sonic INFO systemd[1]: Started dash-ha.service - DASH HA container.
syslog.1:3568:2025 Nov 20 14:00:44.531933 sonic NOTICE systemd[1]: dash-ha.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=255/EXCEPTION
syslog.1:3569:2025 Nov 20 14:00:44.532120 sonic WARNING systemd[1]: dash-ha.service: Failed with result 'exit-code'.
```

comments.author: vivekkarri
comments.body:
@saiarcot895 / @zjswhhh 

Fixing this on DPU should be straightforward IMO

```
-ExecCondition=/bin/bash /usr/local/bin/is-npu-or-dpu.sh
+ExecCondition=/bin/bash /usr/local/bin/is-npu-or-dpu.sh -n

is-npu-or-dpu.sh script already has logic to check if the platform is NPU or DPU. We can leverage that here and only enable on NPU.
```

However, on NPU. 

systemd-sonic-generator masks dash-ha.service but doesn't mask dash-ha@dpux service. Need to put some thought there on how to fix that

#### Why I did it

 Fixes #24543

Despite reworking systemd-sonic-generator in 78edc2e572419e55ee4e4ff4155aacd6623982ff, the dash-ha service files (and the dpu\* instances) still need to be masked for proper functionality. This is because the container needs to be in a disabled state by default; however, SONiC configs that might be loaded might not say anything about the dash-ha feature.

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it

When building the image, bring back the change that was done in #21621 to symlink the dash-ha instances to `/dev/null` by default.

#### How to verify it

Tested on a smartswitch platform and verified that the dash-ha service did not start up.
